blocks.text: You can connect your Bitwarden organization to Advanced SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) to continuously monitor and correct Software as a Service (SaaS) security posture and ensure regulatory compliance is maintained across the organization.
A user with Owner privileges is required to connect Advanced SSPM to your Bitwarden organization.
To connect your Bitwarden organization to Advanced SSPM:

blocks.item: Click Connect in the upper-right corner of the SaaS Dashboard.
From the drop-down menu, select Bitwarden.
In the Add Integration window, enter the Bitwarden Domain Suffix (e.g., com, eu), Client ID, and Client Secret, and then click Connect.

blocks.text: You can find the Client ID and Client Secret on the Organization info page of the Bitwarden Admin Console. To learn more, refer to the Bitwarden documentation.
Your Bitwarden organization is now connected. After integration is completed, a success message appears, and the tenant details are updated on the Settings page.
